metadata.question: Was there more sediment in the Mekong River, specifically at location (20.248364, 100.141422), in January 27, 2015 compared to January 25, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare sediment levels in the Mekong River at a specific location (20.248364, 100.141422) between January 27, 2015 and January 25, 2020. For sediment analysis in rivers, we can use: 1. Surface reflectance data - higher reflectance in visible bands often indicates more suspended sediment 2. Landsat 8/9 or Sentinel-2 data 3. Focus on the red or near-infrared bands as sediment proxies Strategy: 1. Use Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance data (available for both dates) 2. Create a small buffer around the point to sample river pixels 3. Use the red band (B4) as a sediment proxy - higher values typically indicate more suspended sediment 4. Cloud mask the images 5. Compare mean reflectance values between the two dates Let me check if Landsat 8 data exists for both dates and handle any missing data cases. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([100.141422, 20.248364]); const buffer = point.buffer(500); // 500m buffer to capture river area // Date ranges for comparison const date2015 = ee.Date('2015-01-27'); const date2020 = ee.Date('2020-01-25'); const dateRange = 3; // +/- 3 days tolerance // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 8 Surface Reflectance function getL8Collection(targetDate, daysBuffer) { const startDate = targetDate.advance(-daysBuffer, 'day'); const endDate = targetDate.advance(daysBuffer, 'day'); return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(function(image) { // Apply cloud mask using QA_PIXEL band const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // Cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // Cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)); // Dilated cloud // Scale reflectance bands and apply mask const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return opticalBands.updateMask(cloudMask).copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']); }); } // Get collections for both years const col2015 = getL8Collection(date2015, dateRange); const col2020 = getL8Collection(date2020, dateRange); // Check collection sizes const size2015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2015 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites to reduce noise const img2015 = col2015.median(); const img2020 = col2020.median(); // 3. Processing - Use red band (B4) as sediment proxy const band = 'SR_B4'; // Red band // Calculate mean reflectance in buffer const stats2015 = img2015.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = img2020.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine(ee.Reducer.mean(), '', true), geometry: buffer, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2015 = stats2015.get(band).getInfo(); const stats2020Result = stats2020.getInfo(); const mean2020 = stats2020Result[band + '_mean']; const count2020 = stats2020Result[band + '_count']; console.log(`2015 Mean Red Reflectance: ${mean2015 ? mean2015.toFixed(4) : 'No data'}`); console.log(`2020 Mean Red Reflectance: ${mean2020 ? mean2020.toFixed(4) : 'No data'}`); console.log(`2020 Valid Pixels: ${count2020}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (mean2015 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2015) || isNaN(mean2020) || count2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (mean2015 > mean2020) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
